title: Expose workspace-root pnpm scripts as Nx targets and add an Nx version check to the toolchain validator
objective: The owner installed Nx globally so they can run everything through `nx` alone. Add a root-level Nx project exposing every workspace-root package.json script (graph:*, docs:check, ai:check, ai:audit) as an Nx target, and extend tools/scripts/validate-toolchains.ps1 to check the local pinned Nx version against package.json and report whether the newly-installed global Nx is consistent with it.
risks: A root-level project.json makes the workspace root itself an Nx project; must confirm `nx show projects` still lists exactly the expected set (13 existing + this new root one) and nothing regresses.
Per DEC-053/ADR-0015, this task prepares uncommitted changes only; the repository owner reviews and creates the actual Git commit.
